name: Eddy Bear
source: The life from the point of view of a teddy bear (named and dressed in honor of Edward Scissorhands) that lives in Japan with Cammy, a not very bright teen, who decides to run away from home to fulfill her dream of being a singer, with some small pleasurable encounters along the way.​
translation: 从一只泰迪熊（以剪刀手爱德华的名字和服装命名）的角度来看，它与卡米一起生活在日本，卡米是一个不太聪明的青少年，她决定离家出走以实现她成为一名歌手的梦想，一路上遇到了一些小而愉快的遭遇。
